Name: Adjustable Monster Eradication Goal
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Adjustable Monster Eradication Goal allows you to change the count needed to achieve each monster slayer quests. 

Allows you to make the goals for each monster super easy or really hard. It's up to you. 

Two separate files for Android since it does not work with GMCM.  The two files are (1) double the monster slayer quests and (2) half the monster slayer quests. You can also manually modify the content file which avoids the need for GMCM.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Download the mod.  Extract into the same folder as other mods. 

[b]Requirements[/b]
Content Patcher
